facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2019-0088 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 24 May 2019 following 5 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2008-004, INC-2009-009 and INC-2021-020. The management of change record covers 9 clauses across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
